transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi, I was just transferred from the automated system regarding my billing & payments.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Hello WILMA, I can see you were routed here for billing & payments. I have your account information from the system. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: System
transcript.text: Agent match confidence: 75% - Specialized in Billing & Payments

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Of course, I'd be happy to help you with that. Let me pull up your account.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I see a charge for $89.99 that I don't recognize.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can see that charge here. It appears to be for the premium service upgrade from last month.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Premium service upgrade? I don't recall authorizing any upgrade.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me check the details. It looks like it was activated on June 15th.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: June 15th? That doesn't sound right. I've been on the basic plan for years.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Understood. The system indicates an upgrade request was processed from your account.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Is there a way to see how it was requested? Like, if it was online or by phone?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: One moment, please. Yes, it shows here it was an online request.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Online? I definitely didn't do that. Could someone else have accessed my account?
